nm:output.nm:control_stream: $PROBLEM est-fo-posthoc - First-order (METHOD=0) estimation with POSTHOC etas $INPUT ID TIME AMT RATE EVID CMT SS II ADDL DV MDV ROWID $DATA data.csv IGNORE=@ $SUBROUTINES ADVAN2 TRANS2 $PK CL = THETA(1)*EXP(ETA(1)) V = THETA(2)*EXP(ETA(2)) KA = THETA(3) S2 = V $ERROR IPRED = F W = THETA(4)*IPRED IF (W .EQ. 0) W = 1 IWRES = (DV - IPRED)/W Y = IPRED + W*EPS(1) $THETA (0, 3) (0, 30) (0, 1.2) (0, 0.1) $OMEGA 0.09 0.04 $SIGMA 1 FIX $EST METHOD=0 MAXEVAL=9999 POSTHOC PRINT=5 NOABORT $COV UNCONDITIONAL $TABLE ID TIME EVID ROWID IPRED IWRES ONEHEADER NOPRINT FILE=run.tab $TABLE ID ETAS(1:LAST) FIRSTONLY ONEHEADER NOPRINT NOAPPEND FILE=run.eta
